```{r}
# counts from LCL samples
counts_lcl <- read.csv(file.path(pipe_dir, 'counts_lcl.csv'))

##FIXME idk how to do multiple groups or iterate to make this less cumbersome
# trying with just MS1777 vs DMSO first
sub_lcl <- counts_lcl[1:9]

# converting to DGE list & grouping
my_groups <- rep(1:2, each = 4)
dge_sub_lcl <- DGEList(counts = sub_lcl, group = my_groups)

# filter out low counts
keep <- filterByExpr(dge_sub_lcl)
dge_sub_lcl <- dge_sub_lcl[keep, , keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]

# normalizing by library size
dge_sub_lcl <- normLibSizes(dge_sub_lcl)

# est dispersion & testing for DEGs
y <- estimateDisp(dge_sub_lcl)
et <- exactTest(y)
topTags(et)

df <- as.data.frame(et)

# converting ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbol
genes <- df$gene_id
annots <- select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=genes, 
                columns="SYMBOL", keytype="ENSEMBL")

df <- merge(df, annots, by.x="gene_id", by.y="ENSEMBL")

# annotating DEGs as no/up/down regulated
df$diffexpressed <- "NO"
df$diffexpressed[df$logFC > 0.6 & df$PValue < 0.05] <- "UP"
df$diffexpressed[df$logFC < -0.6 & df$PValue < 0.05] <- "DOWN"

# create a new column for the names of the top 30 DEGs
df$delabel <- ifelse(df$SYMBOL %in% head(df[order(df$PValue), "SYMBOL"], 30), df$SYMBOL, NA)

# volcano plot
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(PValue), col = diffexpressed, label = delabel)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.6, 0.6), col = "gray", linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "gray", linetype = 'dashed') + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "grey", "#bb0c00"), # set the colors  
                     labels = c("Downregulated", "Not significant", "Upregulated")) + # to set the labels 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 250), xlim = c(-10, 10)) + # set coordinate limits
  labs(color = 'Severe', # legend title 
       x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"), y = expression("-log"[10]*"p-value")) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, 2)) + # customize breaks in the x axis
  ggtitle('LCL cells in MS177 vs DMSO') + # plot title
  geom_text() ##FIXME idk how to make this look better
 

```


```{r}
group <- c(1,2)
counts <- readDGE(c("lcl_d_1_counts.tabular", "lcl_m_1_counts.tabular"), group=group)

keep <- filterByExpr(counts)
y <- counts[keep, , keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]

y <- normLibSizes(y)

z <- estimateDisp(y)

et <- exactTest(z)
topTags(et)
```
